source_instruction: i would like a corgi dog cosmetic bag for my nail art.
query: Ugh, I swear the barista at the corner café messed up my order again this morning—they put oat milk in my latte when I explicitly asked for whole, and then they tried to argue I’d misspoken when I pointed it out, plus the neighbor’s tabby keeps sneaking into my apartment to knock over my potted succulents and I had to chase it out twice before I left today, and I still haven’t found my favorite fuzzy socks that went missing after laundry last weekend. Since you probably don’t have any of the nail art stuff I’m looking for anyway, I guess I’ll just check out whatever corgi dog-themed bags or cases you have here, right? Wait no—actually, no, hold on, I do need to find a bag or case with nail art designs, preferably with a cute corgi dog motif on it too, and it has to be under $20, yeah?
